scope: Historical corpus audit projection, observed epoch records and per-output development advisory judgments; no protected final prompts/keys.

historical_corpus_audit.json.projection: Per-record audit fields; questions, source passages and endpoints omitted. Historical exposed corpus, not fresh final cohort.

original_control_membership.json.projection: Membership/provenance only; no control questions or keys.

gemma_muse_epochs.json.projection: Per-epoch metrics, run and data identity; private paths scrubbed.

architecture_epochs.json.projection: Recorded eight-run matrix; private paths scrubbed. Does not reload weights.

development_outcomes.json.projection: Every counted output identity, outcome and advisory dimensions; judgment-directory path omitted. No prompt/answer text.

evidence_snapshot.json.projection: Reviewed aggregate receipt snapshot; no new human judgments.
